subject: general
question: Which two countries conducted the first bilateral tri-service exercise 'Konkan Shakti 2021'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India and UK.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The** India – UK Joint Tri-Service exercise Konkan Shakti was held in India From 21 - 27 October 2021.**
 
• 'Konkan Shakti 2021' among the Armed Forces of India and the United Kingdom (UK) was held on the Konkan coast of the Arabian Sea.
 
• As a fragment of the exercise,** ****troops of the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force** were deployed for marine landing in close **coordination with the para drop of airborne troops****, which **they noted is known the as** Tri-Service exercise.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__**

 
• 11th edition of the joint** Indo-Maldives training exercise "Ex-Ekuverin" between India and Maldives was conducted at Kadhdhoo islands, Maldives.**
 
• The** 37th edition of India-Indonesia Coordinated Patrol (CORPAT) was organized in the Indian Ocean from 23-24 November 2021. **CORPAT is organized twice a year to confirm security.
 
• From the **8th to the 19th of December 2019, India and Russia conducted a joint tri-services exercise called '****INDRA 2019′ at Babina, Pune, and Goa.**
